items.t: Ciprofloxacin, oral, 1 g as a single dose. · Adjust antibiotic choice, according to the sensitivity of the isolate responsible for the local epidemic.

adjustments.t: Avoid unless no alternative; used in children only for specific indications

contraindications.t: History of tendon disorders with quinolones

cautions.t: Absorption reduced by antacids, iron, calcium and zinc

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, diarrhoea, tendinitis and tendon rupture, QT prolongation, seizures, peripheral neuropathy, dysglycaemia, C. difficile
